subject.title: fix(shared): re-throw non-ENOENT errors in ignore-rules file reading

question: Should an unreadable ignore file abort skill/resource discovery, or should discovery continue while surfacing a warning or diagnostic?
rationale: The patch changes a shared best-effort discovery path into fail-closed behavior, and source-level correctness cannot determine the intended compatibility policy for existing workspaces.

options.title: Continue with diagnostic
options.body: Keep discovery usable, silently tolerate only ENOENT, and surface other read failures as explicit warnings or diagnostics.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Allow non-ENOENT reads to abort discovery, but require maintainer approval plus fresh-install and upgrade proof showing the resulting user-facing error path.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Close the PR if ignore files are intentionally best-effort and maintainers do not want additional diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Continue with diagnostic
recommendation.body: Keep discovery usable, silently tolerate only ENOENT, and surface other read failures as explicit warnings or diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent skills, shared-runtime, and filesystem-hardening work makes this the best available routing candidate, although exact file-level ownership is uncertain.
